links.outcome: Share of radiation oncology device recalls attributed to software root cause
links.effect: Software issues were the most common root cause (45%), exceeding 50% in 6 of 11 years; 68 AI-enabled RO devices recalled, 62 (91.18%) involving a single planning system.
links.quote: Software issues were the most common root cause (45%), exceeding 50% in 6 of 11 years.

unlisted_practices: Postmarket surveillance of FDA recalls for AI-enabled devices
Rigorous commissioning and revalidation of radiation oncology software

screen.reason: Retrospective epidemiological/surveillance study of FDA medical device recalls (2015-2025) involving radiation oncology software and AI-enabled devices to identify postmarket safety trends and root causes.
